records.scope_note: One source-qualified PA12 polymer representative identified in the study by the EOS PA2200 trade designation. Composition, not supplier name, print technology, post-processing or age, defines identity. No existing unfilled PA12 identity was identified in the frozen catalog; its PA12-CF15 observations are separate filled-formulation evidence and are not admitted here. This representative does not establish chemical purity, an additive-free formulation, or universal equivalence among PA12 grades. HP PA12 and all other PA12 products remain outside this packet; different manufacturer labels alone do not support additional identities.
